research_rationale:
Identity and text: the held original is the Federal Register text (73 FR 36787 (Federal Register, June 27, 2008)) of Executive Order 13466 of June 26, 2008, Continuing Certain Restrictions With Respect to North Korea and North Korean Nationals. I read the held text in full; its title, number, date and Federal Register pages agree with the register row and the packet. The held text is the Federal Register text; its operative text and inventory were read in full. The clause inventory has 12 clauses and matches the text I read. Status YES is retained on the established original_plus_bounded_search route: the held original; no own-terms end (the order has no sunset, expiry or self-revocation); every held later instrument that names the order is either attached as a later event or explained in the earlier-end check as not acting on it; the national-emergency predicate; and the three bounded searches. Emergency predicate: The order rests on the national emergency with respect to North Korea declared in Executive Order 13466 (expanded in scope by later orders). The held presidential continuation notices selected in the packet run from 2009-06-24 to 2026-06-22 (17 notices, each naming the order by number); the latest, the notice of 2026-06-22 (91 FR 38231; FR Doc. 2026-12836), continues the emergency beyond June 26, 2026, so the emergency was in force on 2026-10-14. The packet's selectable notices omit the years 2014 between the first and last held year; I do not rely on those years, and the latest notice itself continues an existing emergency. Searches selected after reading their coverage notes in the packet: current-law:usc (U.S. Code release point 119-121, statute text and editorial notes, edition current through 2026-10-09, so laws enacted from 2026-10-10 through 2026-10-14 are not reflected), current-law:ecfr (eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 and GovInfo CFR bulk XML, 49 titles read) and later-events:ofr_catalog (Federal Register executive-order catalog disposition notes, 6942 catalog records, plus operative sentences in 16784 saved order texts). Each is marked complete with no coverage warning; they are machine leads, and I read the held later texts myself. Cut-off: every clause is decided as of 2026-10-14. The Federal Register text of the order was read from the machine-extracted text layer of the official PDF held at the original path; I confirmed identity from the heading, number, date and FR pages, not from page images.
